name: The Adventurer
summary: At Dun Morogh’s southern gate, The Adventurer carries supplies toward Kharanos. Mountaineer Thalos asks travelers to bring provisions to Eric Brighthammer, a newcomer camped just outside the village.

sections.title: A Favor for the Mountaineers
sections.body: Mountaineer Thalos keeps watch at Dun Morogh’s southern gate, where the trail leaves Coldridge Valley. Guarding the high passes and tunnels keeps the Mountaineers busy. Thalos also watches for dangers and travelers on the road. When a lone adventurer arrives near Kharanos, he asks trusted passersby to carry supplies onward. The bundle is meant to help newcomers venturing into the frozen crags.

sections.title: Supplies for Kharanos
sections.body: The road from the southern pass winds down to Kharanos, a center of dwarven craft and travel in central Dun Morogh. Eric Brighthammer has recently made camp just outside the village. Carrying the Mountaineers’ provisions to him links the sentries on the ridge with those walking the wilderness.

faq.q: Who starts the quest The Adventurer?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos asks travelers for help from his post at the mountain pass gate, where the Coldridge Valley trail enters Dun Morogh.
Eric Brighthammer is an adventurer who recently arrived outside Kharanos. Mountaineer Thalos asks travelers to bring him a bundle of supplies.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take place?
faq.answer: The delivery goes to Eric Brighthammer’s camp just outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. It lies north of the Coldridge Pass tunnel, where Mountaineer Thalos is posted.

faq.q: Why is Mountaineer Thalos sending supplies?
faq.answer: The Mountaineers keep watch over travelers across Dun Morogh. When Thalos hears that an adventurer has camped near Kharanos, he arranges provisions to support him in the cold.
You carry a Supply Bundle from Mountaineer Thalos to Eric Brighthammer.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde players?
faq.answer: No. Mountaineer Thalos is a dwarven guard aligned with the Alliance, so the work is for Alliance travelers.

angles.text: As a dwarf leaving Coldridge Valley, you carry provisions to Eric Brighthammer and help the Mountaineers in Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance traveler, you carry supplies along the icy roads to allies camped outside Kharanos.
